title: Chick with Smartphone
description: A large yellow chick wearing a purple bandana sits on a gnarled tree branch, angrily holding up a smartphone that displays a selfie of itself. A translucent purple ghost floats to the left while a small steampunk robot stands to the right, both on the same branch.
prompt: A surreal fantasy painting shows an angry yellow chick wearing a purple bandana perched on a twisted dark tree branch, holding a black smartphone up to take a selfie of itself. The phone screen shows the chick posing. A translucent purple ghost with a smiling face floats nearby on the left, while a small metallic steampunk robot stands on the right side of the branch. The background features a swirling starry night sky with a large orange sun or moon, rolling green hills with small houses below, all framed by a circular red border decorated with repeating patterns of yellow chicks, ghosts, and suns.
